## The Importance of Saving Electricity
It is impossible to imagine the modern world without electricity because it enables the work of all the gadgets and household appliances that make everyday life easy and convenience.
Furthermore, business, medical, production, and all the other industries need electricity to work.
We use a lot of electricity to light our houses, to heat our houses, to cook our food, and to drive our cars.
Electricity is made by using coal, oil, or gas to heat water to make steam.
The steam then turns a wheel, and the wheel makes the electricity.
When we burn coal, oil, or gas to make electricity, it pollutes the air and it makes the earth warmer.
So, it is important to save electricity so we do not pollute the air and we do not make the earth warmer.
There are many ways to save electricity.
One way is to turn off the lights when you leave a room.
Another way is to not use the light when it is not dark.
You can also save electricity by not use the television or the radio when you are not in the room.
And if you can, walk or ride a bike instead of driving a car.
You can also save money by saving electricity.
If you save electricity, you will not have to pay as much money for it.
That means you will have more money to spend on other things.
There are many reasons why it is important to save electricity.
First, it is good for the air and the earth.
Second, it saves money.
So, please save electricity.

## What is the Middle East?
many children ask their parents, and many people ask themselves the same thing when they see a map of the world, or when someone says something about the Middle East.
What is the Middle East?
It is a question that is easy to ask, but not so easy to answer.
The name "Middle East" is a name that the people in Europe gave to the country between their country and India, and that is all.
Now the people in America call it the Middle East too, but they do not know much about it.
The people in the Middle East do not like the name, because it is not fair to call all those countries the same, because they are all different.
If you go to Turkey, and then you go to Egypt, you will see that they are very different.
